questions.a: THE FIRST LIVE FIRE TAUGHT THE CHECK, CROSSING ONE: qwen2.5:7b quoted the founding source verbatim but wrapped every anchor in literal quotation marks — all three honest quotes refused as fabricated. JUDGED, NOT REPAIRED: a candidate is returned unchanged with its findings — a stage that silently fixes drafts trains its own blind spot; disposition is the caller's (CC today, the librarian later).

QUALITY IS NOT IN THE CHECKS' JURISDICTION, SAID LOUD: the live PASS's what/why are a mediocre paraphrase (the draft calls CC 'the user'); the checks catch fabrication and shape, not meaning-drift (words-kept-meanings-replaced) — that catch is CC's and Akien's by read (edge c), and in the cocoon design it is exactly what CC's free-riding inspection pass exists to post-process and feed back.
